discern 0.0.0 · <PLATFORM> · git 0.00.0

━━ ◮ EXECUTION MODEL ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
  What runs when you call each verb:
    [project] your configured command
    [discern] a built-in step

  → Run `discern doctor --verbose` to show hints explaining each execution step.

━━ ◮ DONE ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Before you call a change done — the full gate.
  [discern] merge-check — verify this branch contains the trunk — the shared
            landing branch — before running the gate (no-op in the main
            checkout)
  [discern] standards-limits-check — verify no [standards] limit loosened or
            vanished versus the trunk (vacuous when none are configured)
  [discern] tracked-artifacts-check — verify discern-managed ignored artifacts
            are not tracked by Git (`git rm --cached` if tracked)
  [discern] instructions-check — verify the agent files match their sources
            (`discern refresh` if stale)
  [discern] skills-check — verify the materialized skills match the effective
            set (`discern refresh` if stale)
  [discern] tracked-refresh-check — verify `discern refresh` has no pending
            effect on tracked files (run refresh, review, and commit if it does)
  [project] format — true
  [project] build — true
  [project] lint — true
  [project] typecheck — true
  [project] test — true
  [project] smoke — true
  [discern] tracked-refresh-check-proof-boundary — repeat the tracked refresh
            plan after every gate job, immediately before issuing the result and
            proof

━━ ◮ PREPARE ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
The fast inner loop while you iterate (fix, regenerate, then check; no build
jobs, no tests).
  [project] format — true
  [project] lint — true
  [project] typecheck — true

━━ ◮ TEST ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
The test suite on its own, outside the full gate.
  [project] test — true
  [project] smoke — true

━━ ◮ STANDARDS ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
On demand — the full standalone measurement pass (always measures, never
replays): deferred standards, pinning a gain, CI. The gate already measures the
rest on every `discern done`.
  (nothing configured)

━━ ◮ TIDY ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Directly, or when the project's format job invokes it during the gate.
  [discern] configured-markdown (when Markdown is selected and a target would
            change)
  [discern] root-discern-toml (when TOML is selected and the root config would
            change)

━━ ◮ START ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
When you begin a new line of work — create a fresh isolated worktree and set it
up (also the WorktreeCreate hook's path).
  [discern] add-worktree — create the linked worktree on its agent/ branch
  [discern] ensure-branch — put the worktree on a named branch
  [discern] complete-refresh — run the complete refresh reconciliation for
            shared files and checkout-local Agent artifacts

━━ ◮ WORKTREE ENSURE ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
On every linked-worktree session start — reconcile any resource declaring an
`ensure`, then re-run checkout-shared and worktree-only convergence. Idempotent
and a no-op in the main checkout.
  (nothing configured)

━━ ◮ UPDATE ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
When bringing the trunk (or an explicit --from ref) into this branch. If there
is nothing to merge, the complete refresh and convergence tail still runs.
  [discern] merge — merge main into the worktree branch (only when the branch
            does not already contain the source)
  [discern] auto-resolve-generated-conflicts — take the incoming side of
            generated conflicts before regeneration (after a real merge, before
            regeneration)
  [discern] complete-refresh — run the complete refresh reconciliation for
            shared files and checkout-local Agent artifacts
  [discern] commit-regenerated-artifacts — after a merge, commit successfully
            re-derived tracked paths whose bytes changed; without a merge,
            report changed tracked refresh paths for review and an intentional
            commit

━━ ◮ ACCEPT ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
When the work is done and updated — prove the exact tree by a valid Proof or a
full gate rerun, recheck tracked refresh convergence with the current engine,
then fast-forward the trunk and clean up.
  [discern] tracked-refresh-check-landing-boundary — after proof or gate
            validation, verify the current engine's refresh plan has no pending
            tracked-file effect
  [discern] fast-forward-trunk — main → the worktree branch in the trunk
            checkout
  [discern] reconcile-proof-note-fetch — remove only proof-note fetch mappings
            discern previously managed
  [discern] write-proof-note — attach the landed proof under refs/notes/discern
  [discern] materialize-local-agent-artifacts — materialize only ignored/local
            Agent artifacts in the trunk checkout
  [project] smoke — true
  [discern] check-trunk-checkout — report tracked dirt present immediately after
            landing or introduced by ensure/smoke convergence
  [project] teardown-resources — no configured resource destroy command (skipped
            for this configuration)
  [discern] remove-worktree — the worktree directory
  [discern] delete-branch — the worktree branch (merged into main)

━━ ◮ WORKTREE PRUNE ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Housekeeping — sweep stale worktrees and reclaim resources orphaned by a
worktree that vanished without a clean teardown.
  [discern] remove-worktree (for each stale worktree git no longer tracks)
  [discern] delete-branch (for each fully-merged dangling branch)
  [discern] reclaim-orphan-dir (for each orphan gitlinked directory)

  → Run `discern doctor --verbose` to show hints explaining each execution step.
